Q: How can I fix the "exceeded quota" issue when using AI to generate articles in Laravel? A:

First off, "Open Source" does not necessarily mean "Free". There are plenty of Open Source platforms that operate under a subscription or other types of pricing models.

Secondly, unless you plan on running your own generative AI model on your own server, then no, you're not going to be able to skirt around the quota issue. Artificial Intelligence is wildly expensive. The hardware requirements alone to run a decent model will require a small mortgage, so expecting a "100% free alternative to GTP" (sic) is naive at best.

If you're going to try implementing AI as a free feature, you might want to consider a licensing model for your user base to recoup a lot of those costs.

Otherwise, consider making your AI implementation an opt-in feature with your users bringing their own keys. Support for multiple AI implementations beyond just ChatGPT (ie: Gemini, Claude, Grok, etc.) should also be taken into account for your user base if you decide to take this approach.
